description: Requests an introduction to a candidate returned by search_candidates. The request goes to the Hire Overseas team, who verify the candidate, confirm availability and pricing, and reply to the contact email, usually within one business day. Requires the requester's real company name and work email. One request covers one candidate.

clientContact.description: The user's work email, where Hire Overseas replies

message.description: Optional note for the Hire Overseas team: start date, hours, budget or anything else about the role

roleTitle.description: Job title the candidate is being considered for, e.g. 'Bookkeeper'

name: request_intro
title: Request an introduction to a candidate
